title: Pro Git figure spec
description: Source format for a Pro Git diagram figure. Rendered to SVG by bin/render-figures.rb.

title.description: Figure title, emitted as SVG <title> for accessibility.

layout.description: Positioning mode. 'grid' (default) places nodes by col/row on a regular grid. 'absolute' uses x/y coordinates directly.

grid.description: Grid pitch in pixels. Overrides the default 127x58.

margin.description: Canvas margin in pixels around all content. Default 4.

canvas.description: Explicit canvas size. If omitted, computed from node extents + margin.

id.description: Unique node identifier, referenced by edges.

kind.description: Symbol kind, mapped to geometry and colors in _palette.json. The '-full' kinds render a large git-object content box (hash label above, key/value rows, optional body text) instead of a plain labeled symbol.

label.description: Text content. String for single line; array of strings for multi-line. Not used by '-full' kinds (use hash/rows/body instead).

hash.description: ('-full' kinds only) Object hash shown as a label above the box.

rows.description: ('-full' kinds only) Key/value table rendered inside the box, monospace-aligned. First row's key is underlined (marks the object type line).

body.description: ('-full' kinds only) Plain left-aligned lines rendered below rows, separated by a blank-line gap. Use an empty string for a blank line.

align.description: ('-full' kinds only) 'center' renders the single header row centered (used for blob boxes); 'left' renders a left-aligned key/value table (used for commit/tree boxes).

x.description: Absolute x coordinate of top-left corner (absolute layout or override).

y.description: Absolute y coordinate of top-left corner (absolute layout or override).

dx.description: Horizontal nudge added to grid-computed x.

dy.description: Vertical nudge added to grid-computed y.

w.description: Width override (uses kind default if omitted).

h.description: Height override (uses kind default if omitted).

fill.description: Fill color override (named key from palette colors, or hex).

text.description: Text color override (named key or hex).

stroke.description: Stroke color override (named key or hex).

route.description: Arrow routing. 'straight' is horizontal or vertical. 'diagonal' is a direct line. 'elbow' has one bend.

arrow.description: Arrowhead placement. 'back' means the arrowhead is at the 'to' end pointing toward 'from' (the Git parent-pointing convention).

style.description: 'muted' renders a thinner, lower-opacity arrow for secondary/background relationships (e.g. pull lines fanning out from a shared remote).

banners.description: Wide block arrows with inset text, used in workflow diagrams (areas, lifecycle, etc.).

thickness.description: Arrow shaft height in pixels. Default 22.

x.description: X position for a vertical rule.

y.description: Y position for a horizontal rule.
